basic_info.description: Charming top-floor Bernal Heights condo in a two-unit building- close to restaurants, supermarkets, parks, and transportation. This upper unit features a light-filled living room, refinished wood floors, a gas fireplace, and views. The remodeled kitchen includes new cabinets, counters and appliances, while the refreshed bath offers a new vanity and toilet. Two bedrooms, one of which has direct access to the kitchen, provide flexible use. The home includes one-car garage parking with storage, a patio with views, and access to a shared yard. A large attic provides excellent additional storage and future possibilities.
